Direct remote output and encrypted packing of virtual sources are unavailable. They provide destination naming, ZIP/7z/TAR/stream format choices, validated compression levels (also encrypted/queued), ZIP comments, foreground/background packing with cancellation and an expandable source list. 7z multi-file/folder creation and encrypted 7z round trips are tested. Existing archive tools provide ZIP/7z AES encryption and guarded Add/Remove/Rename in local ZIP/TAR/7z containers. Writable nested/remote ZIP/TAR/7z sources support guarded outer-container save-back; HTTP and Open As format overrides remain read-only. Links/special files are rejected and broader desktop/format/metadata acceptance remains open. Performance measurements are recorded in docs/PACKING_PERFORMANCE.md. A pinned writer patch fixes empty digest/stream blocks, zero checksums and directory attributes; independent libarchive extraction covers default/fastest/maximum levels and empty/Unicode/nested entries. Official 7-Zip 26.05 integrity and extraction checks pass for plain/AES folders at default/fastest/maximum levels; broader encryption variants, metadata and native acceptance remain open.

mucommander-format-cpio.note: CPIO reading is routed through libarchive, but there is no dedicated CPIO fixture. Creation/mutation and format-specific compatibility are not established.

mucommander-format-gzip.note: Compressed single-file streams support creation, browsing and extraction; creation accepts one regular file. Corresponding compressed TAR containers are also supported. Broad variant, corruption and metadata compatibility remains open.

mucommander-format-iso.note: ISO/NRG reading uses libarchive. ISO browsing/extraction has a dedicated fixture; NRG still needs one. Creation/mutation and broad image/metadata compatibility are not established.

mucommander-format-libguestfs.note: The upstream libguestfs disk/guest-filesystem integration has no Rust implementation.

mucommander-format-lst.note: The upstream LST virtual archive/list format has no Rust implementation.

mucommander-format-rar.note: RAR browsing/extraction use libarchive with a dedicated fixture; creation/mutation is unavailable. Broader variants, encryption and metadata compatibility have not been established.

mucommander-format-rpm.note: RPM reading is routed through libarchive, but there is no dedicated RPM fixture. Creation/mutation and format-specific compatibility are not established.

mucommander-format-sevenzip.note: 7z creation/extraction/browsing, AES encryption/unlock and guarded local repacking edits exist. Writable nested/remote ZIP/TAR/7z sources support guarded outer-container save-back; HTTP and Open As format overrides remain read-only. Link/special-file extraction is rejected. Broader variants/metadata and desktop acceptance remain open. A pinned writer patch fixes empty digest/stream blocks, zero checksums and directory attributes; independent libarchive extraction covers default/fastest/maximum levels and empty/Unicode/nested entries. Official 7-Zip 26.05 integrity and extraction checks pass for plain/AES folders at default/fastest/maximum levels; broader encryption variants, metadata and native acceptance remain open.

mucommander-format-tar.note: TAR and compressed TAR variants can be created, browsed, extracted and edited locally through guarded extraction/repacking. Writable nested/remote ZIP/TAR/7z sources support guarded outer-container save-back; HTTP and Open As format overrides remain read-only. Links/special files are rejected; broader metadata/variant fixtures remain open.

mucommander-format-xz.note: Compressed single-file streams support creation, browsing and extraction; creation accepts one regular file. Corresponding compressed TAR containers are also supported. Broad variant, corruption and metadata compatibility remains open.

mucommander-format-zip.note: ZIP creation, extraction, browsing, AES encryption/unlock and local mutation exist; encrypted edits retain encryption. Writable nested/remote ZIP/TAR/7z sources support guarded outer-container save-back; HTTP and Open As format overrides remain read-only. Link/special-file extraction is rejected; broad metadata, format-variant and desktop acceptance remain open.

mucommander-protocol-adb.note: Android/ADB device browsing has no adapter.

mucommander-protocol-api.note: Shared Location/Entry abstractions, transfer routing and OpenDAL-compatible transport interfaces exist in Rust. Their complete behavioral contract has not been compared with the upstream internal protocol API. This entry is an architecture audit, not another missing network service or a promise of a Java-compatible plugin API.

mucommander-protocol-dropbox.note: Browser OAuth with PKCE, refresh/reconnect and remote file workflows implemented. Protocol tests use loopback fixtures; live provider registration/account validation pending.

mucommander-protocol-ftp.note: Plain and anonymous FTP plus explicit AUTH TLS and implicit FTPS are implemented with selectable ports, certificate/hostname verification and no directory creation on connect. Legacy FTPS profiles retain explicit TLS. Six portable URI workflows include FTP/FTPS/security and writable transfer/recovery cases; Mac results are recorded and native-runner CI is configured. Broader servers and native desktop acceptance remain open.

mucommander-protocol-gcs.note: Google Cloud Storage bucket/prefix navigation and transfers use the existing service-account configuration; direct gs URIs reuse compatible profiles. No live GCS account has been validated; credential and provider-specific behavior remain open.

mucommander-protocol-gdrive.note: Browser OAuth with PKCE, refresh/reconnect and remote file workflows implemented. Protocol tests use loopback fixtures; live provider registration/account validation pending.

mucommander-protocol-hadoop.note: The adapter uses WebHDFS rather than the complete upstream Hadoop filesystem implementation. No live Hadoop cluster has been validated; authentication and full upstream/provider compatibility remain open.

mucommander-protocol-http.note: Read-only HTTP/HTTPS directory-index browsing recognizes Apache, nginx and Caddy listings, including available size/date metadata. Direct files, redirects, range fallback and unknown-length streaming are implemented; signed queries remain session-only. Fixture tests and the live Kew listing pass on Mac. Arbitrary websites are rejected, not rendered; same-origin child links, 8 MiB index/20,000-link bounds and missing server metadata remain documented limits. Broader index/server compatibility remains open. The Windows request failure from CI run 40407268454 is not yet confirmed resolved on a hosted runner; timestamp-only connection IDs were replaced and a concurrent connection/profile/download regression passes locally.

mucommander-protocol-onedrive.note: Browser OAuth with PKCE, refresh/reconnect and remote file workflows implemented. Protocol tests use loopback fixtures; live provider registration/account validation pending.

mucommander-protocol-registry.note: Windows Registry browsing has no virtual-filesystem adapter.

mucommander-protocol-s3.note: S3/S3-compatible bucket/prefix navigation and transfers use configured endpoint, region and credentials. Direct s3 URIs reuse compatible profiles. No live S3 account/service has been validated; provider-specific conditional writes, metadata and recovery remain open.

mucommander-protocol-sftp.note: SFTP is available on Windows, macOS and Linux. Unix key/agent profiles retain OpenSSH; Windows/password profiles use the Rust transport with password/private-key/OpenSSH-agent support and strict known-host verification. Disposable password/key and transfer/recovery workflows pass on Mac; portable fixtures are configured in CI. Windows agent/native desktop acceptance and other server implementations remain open; Rust transport aliases/host certificates are unsupported.

mucommander-protocol-smb.note: Direct Rust SMB2/3 workflows have disposable Samba coverage, including range reads, recursive merges, cancellation/retry, checkpoint publish and sync from macOS. Broader server/platform interoperability remains open.

mucommander-viewer-api.note: Hayro PDF rendering/password unlock, page/rotation/fit controls and bounded cache now include Unicode text extraction, direct page selection/copy, selectable text view and cancellable case-insensitive previous/next document search with wrapping. Glyph limits, missing Unicode maps, complex reading order and OCR/forms/annotations remain documented limits; broader native/PDF compatibility acceptance remains open.

mucommander-viewer-binary.note: Encoded text editing/paging and bounded streaming text/hex search with local byte navigation are implemented. Broader encodings, large remote/archive inputs and upstream interaction parity remain open.

mucommander-viewer-image.note: Bounded renderer/viewer implemented; complete format and interaction compatibility remains unverified.

mucommander-viewer-pdf.note: Hayro PDF rendering/password unlock, page/rotation/fit controls and bounded cache now include Unicode text extraction, direct page selection/copy, selectable text view and cancellable case-insensitive previous/next document search with wrapping. Glyph limits, missing Unicode maps, complex reading order and OCR/forms/annotations remain documented limits; broader native/PDF compatibility acceptance remains open.

mucommander-viewer-text.note: Encoded text editing/paging and bounded streaming text/hex search with local byte navigation are implemented. Broader encodings, large remote/archive inputs and upstream interaction parity remain open.
